answer: Because the basalt lockup is applied by the pigment escrow, the jade audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet thus freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. The bond is locked for 60 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 29 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
